strings.39465: Academy - Used to train elite infantry units, including the Hoplite, Phalanx, and Centurion.
strings.39466: Alligator - Predator that can be hunted for food.
strings.39467: Discovery - Natural sites of significance. Locating all Discoveries is a victory condition. To locate a Discovery, move a unit near it. A colored flag indicates which civilizations have located the Discovery.
strings.39468: Ruins - Ancient structures built by now-lost cultures. Ruins can be a victory condition or increase your score.
strings.39470: Artifact - Ancient objects crafted by now-lost cultures. Artifacts can be a victory condition or increase your score.
strings.39472: Barracks - Used to train infantry, including the Clubman, Axeman, Short Swordsman, Broad Swordsman, Long Swordsman, and Legion. You must build the Barracks before you can build the Archery Range, Siege Workshop, Stable, or Academy.
strings.39473: Fishing Boat - Provides food by gathering fish and depositing them at the Dock. The cargo capacity of a Fishing Boat is greater than the carrying capacity of a villager.
strings.39474: Fishing Ship - Provides food by gathering fish and depositing them at the Dock. The Fishing Ship has more hit points and is faster than the Fishing Boat.
strings.39475: Trade Boat - Used to trade with other civilizations to increase your stockpile of gold.
strings.39476: Merchant Ship - Used to trade with other civilizations to increase your stockpile of gold. The Merchant Ship is faster and has more hit points than the Trade Boat.
strings.39477: Light Transport - Used to transport villagers, military units, and Artifacts across water.
strings.39478: Heavy Transport - Used to transport villagers, military units, and Artifacts across water. The Heavy Transport has more hit points, is faster, and carries more units than the Light Transport.
strings.39479: Scout Ship - The weakest of the war vessels.
strings.39480: War Galley - Upgrade of the Scout Ship. The War Galley has more hit points, attack strength, and range.
strings.39481: Trireme - Upgrade of the War Galley. The Trireme has more hit points, attack strength, and range.
strings.39482: Catapult Trireme - Has fewer hit points and a slower fire rate than a Trireme. But the Catapult Trireme has much more attack strength, range, and is armed with a catapult, which can fire at a location instead of at a particular unit.
strings.39547: Dock - Used to create fishing, trade, transport, and war vessels, including the Fishing Boat, Fishing Ship, Trade Boat, Merchant Ship, Light Transport, Heavy Transport, Scout Ship, War Galley, Trireme, Catapult Trireme, and Juggernaught.
strings.39549: Elephant - Can be hunted for food.
strings.39550: Elephant King - Can be hunted for food.
strings.39552: Farm - Provides a reliable supply of food that can be gathered by a villager. Farms eventually go fallow and need to be rebuilt.

strings.39566: Forager - Gathers food from a Forage Site (berry bush).
strings.39567: Gazelle - Can be hunted for food.
strings.39569: Government Center - Used to build additional Town Centers and research technologies that improve your buildings and military units, including Writing, Architecture, Engineering, Aristocracy, Alchemy, and Ballistics.
strings.39570: Granary - Used to build walls and towers, including the Small Wall, Medium Wall, Fortification, Watch Tower, Sentry Tower, Guard Tower, and Ballista Tower.
strings.39581: Guard Tower - Defensive structure that fires missiles at enemy villagers and military units within range. The Guard Tower has more hit points, attack strength, and range than the Sentry Tower.
strings.39583: House - Supports up to four villagers, military units, or boats. You must have enough Houses before you can create new units.

strings.39592: Lion King - Predator that can be hunted for food.
strings.39595: Villager - Engages in combat or has not been assigned a task.
strings.39596: Market - Used to build the Farm and research technologies that improve your military units and the effectiveness of your villagers, including Woodworking, Artisanship, Craftsmanship, Stone Mining, Siegecraft, Gold Mining, Coinage, Domestication, the Plow, Irrigation, and the Wheel.
strings.39598: Gold Mine - Can be mined for gold.
strings.39603: Stone Mine - Can be mined for stone.
strings.39604: Gold Miner - Gathers gold from Gold Mines.
strings.39605: Stone Miner - Gathers stone from Stone Mines.
strings.39607: Ballista Tower - The ultimate tower. Upgrade of the Guard Tower. The Ballista Tower has more attack strength than the Guard Tower.
strings.39608: Juggernaught - Upgrade of the Catapult Trireme. The Juggernaught has more hit points and causes damage to a larger area. Like the Catapult Trireme, the Juggernaught is armed with a Catapult, which can fire at a location instead of a particular unit.
strings.39609: Helepolis - Upgrade of the Ballista. The Helepolis has more range and a faster fire rate.
strings.39610: Heavy Catapult - Upgrade of the Catapult. The Heavy Catapult has many more hit points and more range.
strings.39611: Heavy Horse Archer - Upgrade of the Horse Archer. The Heavy Horse Archer has more hit points and attack strength.
strings.39612: Legion - Upgrade of Long Swordsman. The Legion is the ultimate infantry unit. It has many more hit points and more attack strength than the Long Swordsman.
strings.39613: Cataphract - Upgrade of Heavy Cavalry. The Cataphract is the ultimate cavalry unit. It has more hit points, attack strength, and armor than Heavy Cavalry.
strings.39614: Centurion - Upgrade of Phalanx. The Centurion is the ultimate elite infantry unit. It has more hit points, attack strength, and armor than the Phalanx.
strings.39617: Priest - Heals friendly and allied units and converts enemy units.
strings.39618: Archery Range - Used to train archers, including the Bowman, Improved Bowman, Composite Bowman, Chariot Archer, Elephant Archer, Horse Archer, and Heavy Horse Archer. You must build the Archery Range before you can build the Siege Workshop.
strings.39619: Repair Man - Repairs buildings and boats damaged in combat.
strings.39624: Sentry Tower - Upgrade of the Watch Tower. The Sentry Tower has more hit points, attack strength, and range.
strings.39625: Shallows - Water that is passable by villagers, military units, and boats.
strings.39626: Siege Workshop - Used to build siege weapons, including the Stone Thrower, Catapult, Heavy Catapult, Ballista, and Helepolis.
strings.39634: Bowman - The weakest of the archers. The Bowman cannot be upgraded. However, you can research the Improved Bowman, which is stronger than the Bowman.
strings.39635: Improved Bowman - Has more hit points, attack strength, and range than the Bowman.
strings.39636: Composite Bowman - Upgrade of Improved Bowman. The Composite Bowman has more hit points, attack strength, and range.
strings.39637: Ballista - Used to attack military units, buildings, and walls. The Ballista has a minimum range of 3.
strings.39638: Stone Thrower - The weakest of the siege weapons.
strings.39639: Catapult - Upgrade of Stone Thrower. The Catapult has more attack strength and range and causes a larger area of damage.
strings.39640: Cavalry - Has more hit points and attack strength (including +5 attack against infantry) than the Scout.
strings.39641: Heavy Cavalry - Upgrade of Cavalry. Heavy Cavalry has more attack strength and armor (including +1 against missile weapons) than Cavalry.
strings.39642: Horse Archer - A fast archery unit with strong attack strength and range.
strings.39643: Chariot - A fast, two-wheel cavalry unit pulled by horses. High resistance to conversion. Double attack against Priest.
strings.39644: Chariot Archer - A powerful archery unit that combines the speed and mobility of the Chariot and the attack strength of the Improved Bowman.
strings.39645: Elephant Archer - Combines the hit points of the War Elephant and the attack strength and range of the Composite Bowman.
strings.39646: War Elephant - A cavalry unit with many hit points and special attack strength. Causes trample damage to adjacent enemy units.
strings.39647: Clubman - The weakest of the infantry units.
strings.39648: Axeman - Upgrade of Clubman. The Axeman has more hit points and attack strength than the Clubman.
strings.39649: Short Swordsman - Has more hit points, attack strength, and armor than the Axeman.
strings.39650: Broad Swordsman - Upgrade of Short Swordsman. The Broad Swordsman has more hit points, attack strength, and armor.
strings.39651: Long Swordsman - Upgrade of Broad Swordsman. The Long Swordsman has more hit points, attack strength, and armor.
strings.39652: Hoplite - The weakest of the elite infantry units.
strings.39653: Phalanx - Upgrade of Hoplite. The Phalanx has more attack strength and armor.
strings.39654: Scout - The weakest of the cavalry units.
strings.39656: Stable - Used to train cavalry units, including the Scout, Cavalry, Heavy Cavalry, Cataphract, Chariot, and War Elephant.
strings.39657: Storage Pit - Used to research technologies that improve the armor and attack strength of military units, including Toolworking, Metalworking, Metallurgy, the Bronze Shield, the Iron Shield, Leather Armor, Scale Armor, and Chain Mail.
strings.39659: Temple - Used to train Priests and research technology that increases their powers, including Polytheism, Mysticism, Astrology, Monotheism, Afterlife, Jihad, and Fanaticism.
strings.39719: Town Center - Used to create villagers and advance to the next age. It is also where villagers can deposit food, wood, gold, and stone. The Town Center supports four units.
strings.39725: Tree - Can be chopped for wood.
strings.39761: Fortification - Upgrade of the Medium Wall. The Fortification has more hit points and is the ultimate wall.
strings.39762: Medium Wall - Upgrade of the Small Wall. The Medium Wall has more hit points.
strings.39763: Small Wall - The weakest of the walls.
strings.39764: Watch Tower - The weakest of the towers.

strings.39814: Slinger - Infantry unit used to defend against early archer and Watch Tower attacks. Has increased attack against archers, walls, and towers. Bronze Shield, Iron Shield, and Tower Shield increase piercing armor. Alchemy increases attack strength. Stone Mining and Siegecraft increase attack strength and range.
strings.39815: Camel Rider - Used to defend against cavalry attacks. Has increased attack against all cavalry, horse archers, and chariots. Camel Riders do not receive a cavalry bonus against infantry. Nobility increases hit points. Toolworking, Metalworking, and Metallurgy increase attack strength. Leather Armor, Scale Armor, and Chain Mail increase armor.
strings.39816: Fire Galley - A fast, powerful, short-range vessel used to defend against other ships. It is superior to the Trireme in one-on-one combat. Takes additional damage from Ballista, Helepolis, Stone Thrower, Catapult, Heavy Catapult, Catapult Trireme, and Juggernaught, whose heavy artillery shatters the Fire Galley's fire pots and sets the ship aflame. You cannot build Fire Galleys if you select the Full Tech Tree option in game setup.
strings.39817: Scythe Chariot - Upgrade of the Chariot. High resistance to conversion; double attack against Priests. Wheels damage adjacent enemy units. Toolworking, Metalworking, and Metallurgy increase attack strength. Leather Armor, Scale Armor, and Chain Mail increase armor.
strings.39818: Armored Elephant - Upgrade of the War Elephant. Increased attack vs. walls & towers, increased armor against Ballista, Helepolis, and missile weapons, and causes trample damage to adjacent enemy units. Attack strength cannot be upgraded. Leather Armor, Scale Armor, and Chain Mail increase armor.
